title: Faculty & Staff Residences
intro: Apartment blocks on campus are home to faculty, staff and their families, with open green space and a play area for children.

photos.alt: A residential apartment block on campus, with parking in front
Residential blocks beside a landscaped lawn
A children’s play area with slides and swings in front of the residences

highlights.title: Apartments
highlights.text: Multi-storey apartment blocks with bright, airy rooms and fitted kitchens.

highlights.title: Green surroundings
highlights.text: The blocks sit among lawns and young trees, within the 47-acre campus.

highlights.title: For families
highlights.text: A children’s play area with slides and swings sits right outside the residences.
